description: Every core noun from one install line: a module preset of seventeen small modules, installed and moved as one set by dt install and dt update.

dreamteamer.title: Core
dreamteamer.description: Every workspace's nouns from one install line, as a module preset: `users` with `teams`, `roles` and `responsibilities`; `companies`, `contacts`, `engagements`; `tasks`; `projects` with `decisions` and `risks`; `meetings` with recordings and docs; `files`; `assets` and `artifacts`; `sessions` and `metrics`; `workflows` — seventeen small modules that `dt install` and `dt update` move together.
